REITs in India: Understanding Real Estate's Mutual Fund Equivalent
Real estate has always been an aspirational investment for Indians, but high capital requirements and low liquidity make it inaccessible for many. Enter REITs – introduced in 2019 to simplify real estate investing. In this video, we explore:
